selection_policy.method: Up to four anchors per model/behavior bucket, selected by deterministic greedy task, suite and condition diversity with SHA-256 tie-breaking; all seven original website examples are additional anchors.
selection_policy.matching: Every available primary peer with exactly the same suite, task, error type, assigned probability and repetition is included. Excluded/missing models remain explicit. No repetition substitution.
selection_policy.scope: Matrix frequencies cover all 16,649 primary episodes, not only selected conversations. Curated anchors and their matched peers are illustrative and are not a probability sample.
selection_policy.realized_failures: Per-episode seeds include model identity. Matched conditions can produce different numbers and positions of faults, including zero injected faults.
selection_policy.trace_completeness: trace_excerpt stores the entire parsed archive JSON member, including all messages and all original top-level fields. Its name exists solely for compatibility with the conversation renderer. No message is shortened.
selection_policy.label_policy: Original rules -> primary judge -> council labels. Re-audit records are shown separately without silently relabeling.

behaviors.definition: empty final answer, regardless of checker outcome

behaviors.definition: final label A, regardless of checker outcome
